messages.author: a146dded6483c593
messages.subject: Help in unpicking problem with user-specified inits
parts:
My first STAN program and running into 'nan' errors in some parameters.

So I tried defining inits but now (R)STAN is complaining

SAMPLING FOR MODEL 'herd_code' NOW (CHAIN 1).
Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : 
  Rejecting user-specified initialization because of vanishing density.
error occurred during calling the sampler; sampling not done

My general question is how do I approach debugging in this situation? 
I'll concentrate on  that before getting to specifics.

Regards

messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Help in unpicking problem with user-specified inits
parts:
Your initialization is bad and the log posterior is overflowing.
There is no immediate solution without seeing your model
but you will some how have to choose better starting values —
make sure that you’re not initializing anything at the boundaries
of constrained variables.
